meta.name: mindustry-speedrun

meta.description:
Speedrun challenge: 45 short stages (Serpulo and Erekir) in a fixed order on one map, each appearing in place the moment the last is cleared; normal and hard. Start from Play > MINDRUN (normal, hard, practice).
Music: Zane Little - Shortcuts (OpenGameArt, CC0)
